content.description: Illustration showing measurement of rotor disc runout using a dial indicator at the outer edge of the rotor disc, with the hub nuts installed in reverse

items: (a) Temporarily install the hub nuts in reverse.
(b) Measure the rotor disc runout at 10 mm (0.39 in.) from the outer edge of rotor disc.

content.text: If the runout is greater than the maximum, replace the disc.

items: (a) Remove the torque plate from the rear axle housing.
(b) Remove the rotor disc and hub nuts.
(c) Install the rotor disc, and adjust the shoe clearance.
(d) Install the torque plate onto the rear axle housing.
